mods.description:
Fixes the bug in Create: Deep Seas where players inside a hermetically sealed
submarine still take fire/lava damage while the submarine is submerged in lava,
even though the interior is correctly emptied of lava.

The fix detects when the player is inside (or climbing out of) a sealed
compartment and suppresses fire/lava damage and the fire overlay in that case.

Requires Create: Deep Seas. Safe to install without it (the fix simply does nothing).

Some related issues are internal to Create: Deep Seas and cannot be fixed from
this mod without altering CDS behaviour — see the mod page for details.

mods.description:
Sound Physics Aeronautics is a fork of Sound Physics Remastered focused on Create Aeronautics and Sable moving sublevels.

It preserves Sound Physics Remastered-style occlusion, reverb, and absorption while adding moving sublevel acoustic support, long-range Aeronautics propeller and optional Create Propulsion thruster audio, Doppler handling for supported moving sources, and safer sound policy behavior for modded Create/Aeronautics packs.

This fork keeps the mod id sound_physics_remastered, so it is a drop-in replacement and cannot be installed alongside upstream Sound Physics Remastered.
